text.text: The Cisco MDS 9148S is a powerful and SAN flexible switch that offers high performance and comprehensive Enterprise-class features in a compact one rack unit form factor. It includes up to 48 auto-sensing line-rate 16 gigabit fibre channel ports. Designed for affordability and flexibility, the base model comes with 12 ports enabled and can be upgraded as needed with a 12-port on-demand license, to support configurations of 24, 36, or 48 active ports. Only the Cisco MDS 9148S provides the flexibility to scale from 12 to 48 16 gigabit fibre channel ports in a single 1RU switch. Whether deployed as a standalone departmental SAN, or as an edge switch in an enterprise data center, installation is fast and simple with PowerOn Auto Provisioning and DCNM quick configuration wizards. In service software upgrades and comprehensive virtual SAN support provide Enterprise-class availability for business resilience.
